doc: SheetCell is a cell of a Sheet.

4.doc: Value is the raw value, e.g. a number in machine notation, which is copied. If empty, Text is copied.
4.name: Value

6.doc: Style is the index of the style plus one, zero is the default style.
6.name: Style

9.doc: Error is shown at the cell, e.g. because the last edit has been rejected.
9.name: Error
